name: skills-registry
description: A curated registry of reusable Claude Code skills for software development teams and agents.

skills.name: fix-issue
skills.description: Fix a GitHub issue end-to-end with code changes, tests, and a commit.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Perform a thorough code review checking correctness, security, performance, and style.

skills.name: write-tests
skills.description: Generate comprehensive tests for existing code covering happy paths, edge cases, and error conditions.

skills.name: commit
skills.description: Create a well-structured git commit following conventional commits specification.

skills.name: pr-summary
skills.description: Summarize a pull request for reviewers or for writing a PR description.

skills.name: explain-code
skills.description: Explain how code works using analogies, ASCII diagrams, and step-by-step walkthroughs.

skills.name: generate-docs
skills.description: Generate documentation: docstrings, API docs, README sections, or architecture docs.

skills.name: debug
skills.description: Systematically debug an error using hypothesis-driven root cause analysis.

skills.name: refactor
skills.description: Refactor code for improved readability and maintainability without changing behavior.

skills.name: security-audit
skills.description: Audit code or a repository for security vulnerabilities including injection, auth, secrets, and dependency CVEs.

templates.name: reference-skill
templates.description: Template for always-on knowledge skills (standards, style guides, conventions).

templates.name: task-skill
templates.description: Template for multi-step workflow skills (deployments, code generation, migrations).

templates.name: isolation-skill
templates.description: Template for skills that run in an isolated subagent (research, analysis, report generation).

categories.documentation: Code explanation and documentation generation skills

patterns.reference: Always-on knowledge skills that Claude applies automatically based on context
patterns.task: Step-by-step workflow skills for repeatable actions
patterns.isolation: Skills that run in a forked subagent with focused, isolated context
